info.title: Instagram API
info.description: Read public Instagram data — profiles, posts, reels, comments, transcripts, and search.

bearerAuth.description: AIsa API key. Get yours at https://aisa.one

get.description: Retrieves comprehensive public Instagram profile information including biography, bio links, follower and following counts, verification status, and profile picture URLs. Also returns recent timeline posts with engagement metrics such as likes, comments, and video view counts, plus a list of related profiles. Useful for account overview, audience analysis, or discovering similar creators.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Instagram handle

parameters.name: trim
parameters.description: Set to true to get a trimmed response

user.biography: Building example.com | The easiest way to get public social media data at scale

get.description: Fetches a lightweight Instagram profile summary by user ID, returning username, full name, biography, profile picture URL, verification status, follower count, following count, media count, and account privacy and type. Ideal for quick lookups or enrichment when you already have the numeric user ID.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Instagram user id

get.description: Returns a paginated feed of a user's public Instagram posts, including reels, photos, videos, and carousels. Each item includes media type, shortcode, caption text, like count, comment count, play count, video URLs, image URLs, and tagged users. Play counts reflect Instagram-only views and exclude cross-posted Facebook views. Supports cursor-based pagination via next_max_id for scrolling through the full timeline.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Instagram handle

parameters.name: next_max_id
parameters.description: Cursor to get next page of results.

parameters.name: trim
parameters.description: Set to true to get a trimmed response

caption.text: 5 best college baseball regional plays for day 1

get.description: Returns a paginated list of a user's public Instagram reels (short-form videos). Each reel includes its shortcode, play count, like count, comment count, video versions with download URLs, thumbnail image, and owner info. Note that reel captions are not returned by this endpoint. Play counts are Instagram-only views and exclude cross-posted Facebook views. Supports cursor-based pagination via max_id; providing a user_id instead of a handle yields faster responses.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Instagram user id. Use this for faster response times.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Instagram handle. Use user_id for faster response times.

parameters.name: max_id
parameters.description: Max id to get more reels. Get 'max_id' from previous response.

parameters.name: trim
parameters.description: Set to true for a trimmed down version of the response

get.description: Lists all story highlight albums for an Instagram user. Each highlight includes its ID, title, cover thumbnail URL, and owner info with username and profile picture. Accepts either a user_id or handle; providing user_id yields faster responses.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Instagram user id. Use for faster response times.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Instagram handle. Use user_id for faster response times.

get.description: Fetches the full contents of a specific Instagram story highlight album by its ID. Returns the highlight's cover image, title, user info, and an items array containing each story with its media type, image or video URLs, dimensions, timestamp, and sticker/interactive element data. Useful for archiving or analyzing individual highlight reels.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Highlight ID. Use `/instagram/user/highlights` to discover current highlight IDs for a public account.

404.description: Highlight not found, deleted, private, or unavailable for the provided highlight ID.

get.description: Returns the raw HTML embed snippet for an Instagram user's profile widget. The response contains a single html string that can be inserted into a webpage to render an embeddable Instagram profile card. Requires the user's handle as input.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Instagram handle

get.description: Fetches detailed metadata for a single Instagram post or reel by shortcode or URL. Returns caption text, like count, comment count, video URL, video play count, video duration, display images, owner info, tagged users, and carousel sidecar children when applicable. Play counts are Instagram-only views and exclude cross-posted Facebook views.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instagram post or reel URL

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: 2 letter country code to set the proxy in

parameters.name: trim
parameters.description: Set to true to get a trimmed response

parameters.name: download_media
parameters.description: Set to true to download the video/images and get back permanent Supabase URLs. Costs 10 credits if media is found, 1 credit otherwise.

get.description: Retrieves comments on a public Instagram post or reel. Each comment includes the comment text, creation timestamp, and commenter details such as username, user ID, verification status, and profile picture URL. Supports cursor-based pagination to load additional comment pages.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The URL of the post or reel to get comments from

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The cursor to get more comments. Get 'cursor' from previous response.

comments.text: "...but who wants to know people who don't love animals anyway?". ❤️

get.description: Generates an AI-powered speech-to-text transcription for an Instagram video post or reel. The video must be under 2 minutes long. Returns a transcripts array with each item's shortcode and transcribed text; carousel posts produce one transcript per video slide. Expect 10-30 second response times, and null when no speech is detected.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instagram post or reel URL

transcripts.text: Let's fry up the perfect bunzel. Beautiful.  Everybody, shh. The perfect bunzel. Let me show you my bunzel. When it comes down to bunzel, we make it the crispiest, get the crunch. Heaven.

get.description: Fetches trending reels from Instagram's public instagram.com/reels page. Instagram only gives a small batch at a time and the results can overlap, so call this endpoint over and over when you want more. Each call should return new-ish results, but expect some duplicates because that is how Instagram's reels page behaves too. Returns `reels`, an array of reel objects with shortcode, URL, caption, media URLs, engagement counts when Instagram exposes them, and user info.

Searches for Instagram reels matching a keyword or phrase via Google Search, bypassing Instagram's login-gated search. Returns a list of reels with shortcode, caption, thumbnail, video URL, play count, like count, comment count, video duration, owner details, location, and audio attribution info. Play counts are Instagram-only views and exclude cross-posted Facebook views. Supports page-based pagination for browsing additional results.

parameters.name: query

reels.caption:
Dogs are family 💙

I met Rocco, a little rescue Chihuahua all the way from Mexico 🇲🇽🐾 

He’s looked after by a lovely lady who’s always had dogs, but when she lost her last one, she thought that was it, the loss is too painful to go through again. But babysitting Rocco gives her her “dog fix” and keeps her connected to the love only dogs can bring 🥰

She’s originally from Los Angeles, but now a New Yorker, and knows Central Park inside out from years of walking dogs there 🌳🐕 

She told me how dogs are family, and people who don’t love animals will never fully understand it, and I completely agree! ❤️

#dogphotography #rescuedog #chihuahua #dogportrait #dogphotographer
